_comment: V4-PLANTMERGE-001 execution manifest. Ids resolved ONCE from live prod 2026-08-14 and frozen here, so a run is reproducible and auditable rather than re-matching plant NAMES at execution time (names are user-editable). Source of groups: planting-merge-plan-V003-20260814.md §1. Winner rule: Dave's ruling where recorded, else ORDER BY min(event_date), created_at, id per plan §4.2 — scripts/merge-run.mjs RE-DERIVES the fallback from live data and refuses to run any group whose manifest winner disagrees unless winner_source is 'dave'.

groups.label: Ghost + Ghost Pepper + Bhut Jolokia
groups.winner_note: Dave ruled: keep the LATER window; the earlier plantings fell behind. The fallback rule would pick Ghost Pepper — it measures import order, not history.
groups.overrides_note: Keeps the winner's 'Ghost' variety over 'Bhut Jolokia'. Bhut Jolokia IS the ghost pepper botanically, so these are two variety rows for one cultivar — another V4-VARIETYDUP-001 instance, not a real divergence.

groups.label: Scotch Bonnet ×2
groups.winner_note: first_event tied to the microsecond (bulk backfill); created_at breaks it. Keeps the unsuffixed name.

groups.label: Serranos + Serrano 2
groups.winner_note: first_event tied; created_at breaks it. Keeps the unsuffixed name.

groups.label: Chili Red + Chili Red (later)
groups.winner_note: Rehearsed 13/13 on a branch off prod 2026-08-14. Status resolves to fruiting, not harvested, after V4-MERGESTATUS-001.

groups.label: Alaska Mix Nasturtium 1 + 2
groups.winner_note: Distinct variety_ids but BOTH named 'Alaska Mix' — a duplicate row in plant_varieties, agronomically benign. Tracked separately as V4-VARIETYDUP-001.
groups.overrides_note: Both variety rows are literally named 'Alaska Mix' — the known V4-VARIETYDUP-001 duplicate. Keeps the winner's row; either is equivalent.

groups.label: French Tarragon ×2
groups.winner_note: Russian tarragon is a DIFFERENT plant and is on the never-merge list; these two are both French.

groups.label: Marigolds + Marigolds (Mixed)
groups.winner_note: 2 live plant_anchor_derivation rows across the pair — the supersede path is exercised here.

groups.label: Purple Vienna Kohlrabi + Seeds
groups.winner_note: Loss figures already written to prod 2026-08-14 (16 initial / 10 lost / 6 alive). The loser's 'germination failure' status was STALE — 2 replants did come up.

groups.label: Cilantro ×2
groups.winner_note: Merged over the crucible's objection — Dave: cilantro succession data is informative, not actionable.
groups.overrides_note: Keeps the LATER archive date (2026-07-30 23:12 ET, from the loser) over the winner's 2026-06-18. The merged row was archived when the last of the pair was.

groups.label: Echeveria ×4
groups.hold_reason: NEEDS A DAVE RULING — same class he ruled on for group 15. Two of these four are DISTINCT NAMED CULTIVARS ('Perle von Nurnberg', "Love's Fire"; the plan itself calls them that), and the fallback winner is the generic 'Echeveria', so merging would fold two named cultivars into an unnamed row and lose that identity. variety_id diverges four ways and Love's Fire carries crop_type_slug='succulent' rather than 'echeveria', so the merged row also needs an explicit crop_type resolution. Options: (a) merge only the two generic rows ('Echeveria' + 'Echeveria (mail order)') and leave the two named cultivars standing, (b) merge all four and accept the identity loss, (c) do not merge. Recommend (a).
